The '''Vaykaaris system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> In approximately [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{CSWECite|III|298|Vaykaaris Uprising}} dates the [[Vaykaaris Uprising]] to approximately 45 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the latter conflict to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Vaykaaris Uprising can therefore be placed in around [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]].</ref> a [[Unidentified terrorist group|terrorist group]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|298|Vaykaaris Uprising}}</ref> based in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="TEA" /> threatened more than a hundred [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in the Colonies in what became known as the [[Vaykaaris Uprising]]. To resolve the dispute, twelve members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] were dispatched aboard the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[FarStar|''Freedom's Messenger'']].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vaykaaris system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-13.<ref name="TEA" />
